_note: Default bindings; the player can rebind keyboard and mouse actions on the Controls screen (saved in settings). Keyboard values are KeyboardEvent.code; Mouse0 / Mouse1 / Mouse2 are the left / middle / right mouse buttons and the wheel also sets the torso angle (scroll up = torso down). The J / L and I / K keys are always bound alongside the mouse so a Chromebook touchpad works too. Gamepad uses the W3C standard mapping (buttons b0..b16, axes a0..a3). Throw is the QB throw control (the placement reticle, docs/passing.md): it acts only while you hold the ball. Slide (Ctrl) is a feet-first slide for anyone; Ctrl+W still closes a browser tab outside fullscreen, so the game asks first while a rep runs.
